commentary_title: VLGC earnings waver amid US-China tariff war uncertainity
commentary_summary: VLGC spot rates on the benchmark US-Japan route and AG-Japan route rose 15% and 25% WoW, respectively, after falling to $86 per tonne and $39.5 per tonne last week. | Uncertainty caused by the US-China tariff war led Chinese buyers to rush for alternative supplies, boosting spot rates on AG-Japan routes. | Further, tonne mile demand created by diversion of US cargoes towards India and Indonesia resulted in increased spot rates on US- Japan route and led to 3% WoW rise in Drewry's LPG tonne mile index. | The Atlantic ballast tonnage indicator remained high for two consecutive weeks as VLGCs positioned near the US coast to capitalise on widening US Asia price arbitrage.
